verses.gurmukhi: ਅਛਲੁ ਅਛੇਦੁ ਅਭੇਦੁ ਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹੋਇ ਅਛਲੁ ਛਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: achhal achhedh abhedh hai bhagat vachhal hoi achhal chhalaiaa|

en.bdb: The Lord is undeceivable, indestructible and non-dual, but because of His love for His devotees He is sometimes deluded by them (as in the case of 'Guru Amar Das).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਿਤਿ ਮਿਰਜਾਦ ਲੰਘਿ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: mahimaa mit mirajaadh la(n)gh paramit paaraavaar na paiaa|

en.bdb: His grandeur has crossed all the limits and being boyond all the boundaries none could know about his extent.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਹਰਾਸੀ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਜਗੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: raharaasee raharaas hai pairee pai jag pairee paiaa|

en.bdb: Among all the codes of couduct, the code of conduct of the Guru is the best one; he falling at the feet of Guru (Angad) has made the whole world bow at his own feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲੁ ਅਮਰ ਪਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬ੍ਰਿਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukhafal amar padh a(n)mirat birakh a(n)mirat fal laiaa|

en.bdb: The pleasure fruit of the gurmuldts is the state of immortality and on the tree of nectar (Guru Angad) Guru Amar Das, the nectar fruit has grown.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੁਰਖਹੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur chelaa chelaa guroo purakhahu purakh upai samaiaa|

en.bdb: From the Guru emerged the disciple and the disciple became the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਵੀਹਿ ਵਿਸਵੇ ਹੋਇ ਇਕੀਹ ਸਹਜਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: varatamaan veeh visave hoi ikeeh sahaj ghar aaiaa|

en.bdb: Guru Angad the Cosmic spirit ( Purakh) having manifested the supreme spirit, (Guru Amar Das), himself merged in the supreme light.
Going beyond the perceptible world, he established himself in equipoise.Thus, Guru Amar Das has spead the true message.
